moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio attention-bounce, written here): Bell hops in place, origin bottom: y 0 → −16 px (260 ms) → +2 (430 ms) → 0 (620 ms), sine.inOut keys; pre-squash scaleY −4 % (sine bump from −80 to +20 ms around take-off), landing squash scaleY 0.92 (sine bump 360–560 ms), scaleX = 1/scaleY; contact shadow shrinks (−35 %) and fades with height. Once. Params: height (16 px) · squash đáp (0.92) · duration (0.62 s).
